name: Refinishing Around Radiators, Vents, and Built-Ins in Edmonds Homes
title-tag: Refinishing Around Radiators & Built-Ins: Edmonds, WA
meta-description: Radiators stay connected, vents come out, built-ins get protected. How we refinish floors in obstacle-rich Edmonds homes — same $3.99/sq ft, more craft.
post-summary: January 20, 2027 · The field machine does the easy part; everything within a foot of a radiator, register, or built-in is edger and hand work — and in the Edmonds bowl’s pre-war homes that can be a third of the job. Obstacle by obstacle: what we do, what we ask of you, and why the price stays $3.99/sq ft.
